parameters.brief: Prepare a clean sharing cover from the final native gameplay image, excluding editor controls.
parameters.content:
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/webdev-78141c527fd2bee12351e8420e97f2de')
source=Path('/home/ubuntu/fablewood_source/captures/all_tiers_en.png')
im=Image.open(source).convert('RGB');assert im.size==(1440,900)
out=root/'assets/share/source/illuminated_gameplay.png';out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
# Actual scene pixels only: remove top HUD, inspector, action bar and debug controls.
im.crop((30,182,1138,660)).save(out)
print(out)
